ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; dominant white intensity (approx. 65% surface area) against low-intensity black pigmentation (approx. 35% surface area) concentrated at margins and center.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white regions; trailing edges and peduncle attachment area are defined by solid black banding; dense black mottling and circular spots (5-20 pixel diameters) are distributed across the mid-lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees; vertical pixel depth approximately 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency micro-serrations (2-5 pixels) and several distinct macro-notches (10-30 pixels) distributed along both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition with a sharp upward sweep toward the distal tips; trailing edges follow a generally convex path from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips and sporadically along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the white central region of the right lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular indentation/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive calcified parasite colonization on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific cluster of dark, circular pigmentation spots located in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
